title: My first AI game released - Garden Ninja, play it for free!
author: SquartzGames
selftext:
Hello everyone, I made Garden Ninja in just three days using AI.

Garden Ninja is a pixel-art arcade action game where you play as a retired ninja defending his vegetable garden from waves of hungry pests. Throw shuriken, harvest surviving crops, and spend the resources you earn on permanent upgrades like ricocheting blades, explosive hits, and shadow clones. Fight through ten distinct stages, then beat the final pest quota and keep at least one plant alive until time runs out.

I used both Codex (Sol 6.2) and Claude (Opus 5.5) to make the game, assets were done by Codex while the majority of coding was done by Opus. I also used ElevenLabs to generate sound effects and music. It was quite fun and quick to do it, I expect around 1-2 hours of gameplay.

I asked for recommendations for both LLMs and overall it was pretty good, especially with the skill tree and balancing. The game also has 7 languages, all translated by them, so the translation might not be accurate.

If you have no idea what to build, I suggest asking ChatGPT to generate mockups with images of a theme or game genre, then you ask to develop the idea and generate the assets on the mockup you liked, then it's a matter of polishing and adding more content to the game.

  
It's not my first AI game, I have other projects too, but I wanted to release it for free while Steam is reviewing my account. 

You can play it here: [https://squartzgames.itch.io/garden-ninja](https://squartzgames.itch.io/garden-ninja)
